kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Proto-Iranian *Háyxam
Persian یخ (yax)
Persian چال (čâl)
Persian یَخْچال (yaxčâl)lbor.
Arabic يخجال
Learned borrowing from Persian یَخْچال (yaxčâl).
g: yakhchal (a type of icehouse, built mainly in Persia (present-day Iran), that functions as an evaporative cooler, having a domed shape above ground and a subterranean storage space)
